title: Killer Klowns from Outer Space
review: This is meant to be a comedy, but all the funniest parts are unintentional. The dialogue sounds like it was written by someone from outer space. I don't get how someone could build these big crazy sets and go through the whole process of filming a movie, when the script itself hasn't been proof read by a functional English speaking adult. Imagine {Troll 2} except with klowns instead of goblins. It's more competent, but only in the sense that it's the best film {Troll 2} could have been without a total rewrite. The klowns themselves can't move very fast or emote with their giant rubber heads, so they're not that exciting to watch once you've seen them each once. Actual clowns do a lot of exaggerated acting, scurrying around doing big physical comedy that can be seen from the back row of a live audience. You might find it scary if you hate klowns, and can look past the bizarre way characters speak to each other, and the awkward pacing, and the pathetic slow and predictable ending.
spoilers: There's a bit where they didn't want to actually crash a police car when filming, so it just comes to a safe stop near a wall, instead of hitting it, and they cut to the two guys inside banging their heads down on the dashboard.
